extraction: Local-First AI Agent Cost Analysis: Production agent 1000 tasks/day × 8 LLM calls × 2000 tokens = 16M tokens/day. At Claude Sonnet 4 pricing ($3/$15 per million input/output) = $150-300/day per agent instance. Local inference on quantized 7B model (RTX 4090): 300+ tokens/sec, sub-millisecond latency vs cloud round-trip. EU AI Act effective Aug 2 2026 adds data residency requirements. Local-first architecture: faster, cheaper, more private, more available. Not a compromise - superior design philosophy for agent platforms.
